I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-random message to confirm his correction. The Thornbury Cloth Co. signed order form is now due 19 November, not the date he posted this morning. The workspace saves his message automatically, so there was nothing else to do.

I also suggested he post the correction in #north-team. That's where his original post is, so people reading there will still see the old date.
